player.speaker: Front Commissar
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Béla Kun
line.reaction-briliant.text: The northern operation has succeeded beyond anything the Entente allowed for. That success is precisely why Clemenceau's note arrived this morning.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Béla Kun
line.reaction-tactical.text: The advance has stalled, and the note from Paris is timed to exploit exactly that.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Béla Kun
line.reaction-victory.text: The north is held. And now Paris sends us a map with our borders already drawn upon it.
line.callback-eperjes.speaker: Tibor Szamuely
line.callback-eperjes.text: Eperjes is held. In the town hall, workers' and soldiers' delegates argue over a proclamation they intend to make within days, while printers wait for the name to place above it. Paris is demanding our withdrawal before that argument can harden into a government.
line.callback-full-advance.speaker: Tibor Szamuely
line.callback-full-advance.text: Bartfa, Eperjes, Golnicbanya - the whole northern axis. No staff in Europe expected this army to be standing here in June.
line.callback-railway-axis.speaker: Mária Tóth
line.callback-railway-axis.text: I wrote the ammunition trains over Fekete's old evacuation timetable. This time the loaded wagons went north and the wounded came back on schedule. The crews no longer ask whether your orders understand a railway.
line.callback-parallel-columns.speaker: Antonín Janoušek
line.callback-parallel-columns.text: Your parallel columns reached valleys the railway would have passed by, and several villages elected councils before the main force arrived. They also received three different requisition orders. Internationalism cannot sound convincing when every column speaks with a different authority.
line.clemenceau-note.speaker: Béla Kun
line.clemenceau-note.text: The note from Paris lies beside the operations map. Clemenceau offers a frontier and promises Romanian withdrawal if we abandon the northern territories. No Romanian order to withdraw has reached us. The demand for our retreat, however, is already being repeated as an Allied command.
line.szamuely-opening.speaker: Tibor Szamuely
line.szamuely-opening.text: I returned from Moscow with greetings and no army crossing the Carpathians. We hold the north with our soldiers and Slovak workers. Surrender it before Romania moves, and Paris will have reversed a victory by telegram.
line.kun-coalition-answer.speaker: Béla Kun
line.kun-coalition-answer.text: Reject it, and Paris can present every neighbouring army as the enforcement arm of one settlement. The Republic cannot fight Romania, Czechoslovakia and the Entente's diplomacy indefinitely because indignation feels firmer than paper.
line.stromfeld-between-them.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-between-them.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-between-them.text: Take your hands off my map, both of you. Budapest may bargain over the north; the Czechoslovak columns are already moving through it. Commissar, give this front an order it can obey tonight.
line.kun-diplomacy.speaker: Béla Kun
line.kun-diplomacy.text: The Czechoslovak columns are attacking between Nyitra, the Vág and the Garam. Do we hold the crossings and use depth, or concentrate at once and break the strongest column before diplomacy becomes a military fact?
line.kun-diplomacy.choice.elastic-defenc: Hold the river crossings and trade exposed ground for time until our reinforcements arrive.
Fully resupply every core formation and gain an entrenched infantry detachment, but forgo the counterattack's prestige and core-wide experience.
line.kun-diplomacy.choice.local-countera: Concentrate immediately against the strongest enemy column and break the offensive before it develops.
Gain a prestige award and experience for every core formation, but forgo full resupply and the additional infantry detachment.
line.stromfeld-elastic.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-elastic.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-elastic.text: An elastic defence is sound only if the crossings remain organised. Mark the line beyond which no unit withdraws without orders, or controlled movement will become retreat.
line.landler-counter.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.landler-counter.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.landler-counter.text: Then I want the artillery massed before the infantry moves. Strike one column while it is still alone. If eager battalions go early, they will warn the enemy and spend our advantage.
line.szamuely-warning.speaker: Tibor Szamuely
line.szamuely-warning.text: The men hear that Paris can erase the ground beneath them. Give them an order nearer than diplomacy: hold the crossings, keep contact with the next battalion, and beat the column in front of them.
line.stromfeld-final.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-final.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-final.text: Paris may move the frontier later. Today I need three crossings tied to one command. Let the enemy spend its strength against them; counterattack when its columns stop supporting one another.
